scope: Generic reference execution bridge from canonical Behavior IR entrypoints to immutable ReferenceBattleState transitions. This is not the production Battle Runtime and does not claim full client event/scheduler equivalence.

selected_model.compiler: A record is EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE only when every behavior-affecting operation is either EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE or safe headless presentation. A structurally partial record may still expose an independently closed executable entrypoint.
selected_model.runtime: SemanticExecutor consumes only compiled IR, ReferenceBattleState, ExecutionContext and SandboxRng. It rejects non-executable dispositions and missing resolver inputs; it never reads raw source payloads at execution time.
implemented_operation_handlers: ADD_MODIFIER with an explicit canonical Modifier catalog definition and optional selected modifier-local DynamicValues initialization
REMOVE_MODIFIER: named instance mark-destroy only; dirty cleanup remains separate

DAMAGE_REQUEST: selected normal ByAttack/ByMaxHP/ByDefence formula with explicit multiplier context, shield-before-HP commit, optional explicit StanceValue/toughness transition, plus selected AttackType=DOT no-crit ticks
MODIFY_WEAKNESS: selected StackWeakness Attach/WeakList transition with stable entity-state de-duplication
MODIFY_TEAM_SP: selected ModifySPNew AddRatio/AddValue positive post-commit contribution to a bounded shared team SkillPointEntity holder

ordering: Entrypoint operations execute in canonical sibling order. Conditional selects exactly SuccessTaskList or FailedTaskList and then executes that child list in order. Presentation operations are omitted only when the compiler marked gating_risk=NONE.

evidence.support: PostfixExpr evaluation plus immutable define/set/read store
explicit source Stacking definition required before ADD_MODIFIER lowering
local SkillPointEntity holder plus _AddBPAfterSkillUse ordinary post-commit model
selected weakness attachment and state-derived stance eligibility
selected normal damage formula and ordered shield-before-HP survival commit

unsupported_boundary: missing DynamicHash, target alias or predicate provider input
AddModifier with missing/unsupported/conflicting canonical Stacking, chance, lifetime or layer parameters
later callback lookup of modifier-local DynamicValues by instance identity
RemoveModifier with no explicit name, caster/global filters, or immediate dirty cleanup semantics

DamageValue/direct-damage, Break/SuperBreak request families, SPHitRatio, split/AOE sequencing, damage tags, inherited attack fields, missing explicit toughness/Break runtime inputs and non-selected formula types; DOT application/chance/refresh/stack/expiry scheduling remains separate from selected no-crit DOT ticks
ModifySPNew pre-action cost/gate, NoSpCost/cap modifiers, special-mode resource holders and scheduler timing
global event dispatch, action scheduling, modifier callback registration and native reentrancy
production BattleState, legality API, clone/hash contract and Golden game trace claim
coverage_policy: EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE means the canonical operation graph has selected generic handlers and may execute only with all declared context inputs. SOURCE_BACKED_EXECUTABLE is narrower and counts only records run through the bridge with real canonical source payloads. Neither category is Golden-tested.
